## Findings the audit + challenge established (all orchestrator-verified)

- **FOUR events are documented but never emitted**, not three: `table:search`,
  `table:page`, `table:pagesize` (TableView.md:1652-1655) AND `filter:edit`
  (:1676). `ListView.js:2841` literally comments "do NOT emit `filter:edit` here";
  `ListView.js:29`'s JSDoc claiming it exists is stale. `TablePage.js:726-728` has
  dead `off('table:search')`/`off('table:page')` teardown calls.
- **`cell:save:error` is NOT forwarded.** `TableView._createItemView` wires only
  cell:edit/cell:save/cell:cancel (:1189-1191); TableRow.js:829 is the sole emitter.
  Step 2 of the plan adds the forward + a test — REQUIRED before it may appear in
  TableView.md's events table, or you mint a fifth ghost event.
- **`column.width` is inert** — nothing reads it; six example files pass it.
- **`isSelectable()`** = `batchActions.length > 0 && selectionMode === 'multiple'`
  (TableView.js:597-599), so `TableViewRowStripeExample.js:100`'s bare
  `selectable: true` silently renders no checkbox column.
- **`cross-link-docs.js` is orphaned** — not in any npm script; ~10 doc files are
  stale as a result (measured), 6 with no `## Examples` block at all.
- **The build suites do NOT execute example pages** — examples-registry checks
  sourcePath exists, examples-imports is regex-only, examples-coverage is
  folder-level. A route that throws on mount passes `npm test` clean. Live browser
  verification is the acceptance gate.
- **`footer_total`, `align`, string `visibility` are ALREADY exampled**
  (TablePageExample.js:72) — the "zero runnable reference" framing was wrong and
  example #4 is re-cut accordingly.
